what: `.ignore` file management extracted into `src/memory/ignoreFile.ts` (exports `syncIgnoreFile`, `readHideFromGrep`, marker constants). Both `src/memory/init.ts` (updateIgnoreFile) and `src/cli/commands/memory/config.ts` (applySideEffects for `memories.hideFromGrep`) call through here. Marker convention: `# BEGIN aide-memory-managed` / `# END aide-memory-managed`. The syncer only ever rewrites content between the markers and preserves user entries outside them; legacy bare `.aide/memories/` lines (from older init versions) are migrated into the managed block on first sync. `aide-memory config memories.hideFromGrep <true|false>` now resyncs `.ignore` in-process — no more init --force needed.
why: Closes the validation gap documented in PHASE_0_1_VALIDATION_FOLLOWUPS.md (line 395): toggling memories.hideFromGrep previously only wrote to config.json and didn't resync .ignore. Single source of truth for the marker format prevents future drift between init and config paths.
